Looking at the conversation, the WebSurfer agent was the one actively searching and providing information. They started by searching for Abel's Island author, confirming it's William Steig. Then they moved on to searching for the 1982 mouse dentist book, which led them to Doctor De Soto. This could be a case of misattribution or confusion between similar titles.

The mistake likely happened when the WebSurfer agent retrieved the search results and possibly misread or misattributed the title. They might have focused on the first result or didn't cross-check the title properly, leading to the incorrect book being suggested.

So, the error occurred when the WebSurfer agent provided the incorrect book title, which was later corrected. The step number would be when they first mentioned the incorrect title, which was step 4 in their process.
